name: sidebar
behavior: A navigation landmark (<nav> with an accessible name) containing lists of links; the current destination carries aria-current='page'. The collapse control is a toggle button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, and collapsing hides the region from assistive tech only when it is truly hidden. Nested groups follow the APG disclosure pattern (button with aria-expanded controlling the sub-list); sub-lists are real nested lists so depth is announced. On narrow viewports the sidebar becomes an APG dialog (modal): focus is trapped, Esc dismisses, and focus returns to the trigger. Tab order follows visual order; the collapsed rail still exposes every item's name via its accessible name, never via tooltip alone.

parts.note: the nav landmark and its collapse animation
the scrolling body holding the groups
the list item; chrome lives on menu-button

parts.statesNote: the current item takes interaction-selected plus selected-indicator (the active-item bar) — the indicator is what survives a collapsed rail, where the label is hidden

parts.note: the only visible content in the collapsed rail; therefore aria-hidden with the name carried by the button
count/status trailing the label; its meaning is repeated in the accessible name
the nested list; one space-inline-md indent per depth — rhythm, never a raw value

anatomyNotes: Intersection of shadcn Sidebar (a 26-slot composition: sidebar/trigger/header/content/group/group-label/menu/menu-item/menu-button/menu-badge/menu-sub/separator/footer/rail/inset) and Salt VerticalNavigation + NavigationItem (VerticalNavigationItem/ItemTrigger/ItemLabel/ItemContent/SubMenu, with NavigationItem's active and expansion states). The parts above are the intersection; shadcn's structural helpers — wrapper, gap, container, inner, rail, inset, menu-skeleton — are LAYOUT scaffolding for its fixed-position collapse trick, not anatomy, and are omitted (a theme animating width instead of translating a fixed panel needs none of them). shadcn's sidebar-input is the input anatomy composed into the header. Salt marks the active item with an edge bar (selected-indicator) while shadcn uses a filled row (interaction-selected); both slots are declared on menu-button so the difference stays recipe. COLLAPSED versus expanded is not a canonical state — it is the disclosure state of the region, expressed as data-collapsed on root, orthogonal to the item states above. The mobile presentation reuses the drawer/dialog anatomy rather than duplicating it.
